questions.question: If tan X = (m)/(n) and 0° ≤ X ≤ 90°, then the value of (sin X + cos X) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

tan X = m/n

**Formula:**

Pythagoras Theorem

H² = B² + P²

Where, Hypotenuse = H, Base = B and Perpendicular = P

tan x = Perpendicular/Base 

sin x = Perpendicular/Hypotenuse

cos x = Base/Hypotenuse 

**Calculation:**

tan X = Perpendicular/Base = m/n

Perpendicular = m and Base = n

Now,

(Hypotenuse)² = m² + n²

⇒ Hypotenuse = √(m2 + n²)

Now,

sin X + cox X 

⇒ m/√(m2 + n2) + n/√(m2 + n2)

⇒ (m + n)/√(m2 + n2)

questions.question: If 2794p561 is divisible by 9, then the value of p is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

2794p561 is divisible by 9.

**Formula:**

Divisibility law of 9 ⇒ A number is divisible by 9 if sum of its digit is divisible by 9.

**Calculation:**

2 + 7 + 9 + 4 + p + 5 + 6 + 1 

⇒ 34 + p

If we put p = 2, then

⇒ 34 + 2

⇒ 36 (which is divisible by 9)

∴ p = 2

questions.question: A train that is running at the speed of 72 km/h crosses an electric pole in 36 seconds. The length of the train (in metres) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of train = 72 km/hr

The train crosses an electric pole = 36 seconds

**Formula:**

Speed = distance/Time

1 km/hr = 5/18 m/sec

**Calculation:**

Let length of train be x meter

72 × 5/18 = x/36

⇒ x = 72 × 5/18 × 36

⇒ x = 720 m 

∴ Length of train is 720 m.

questions.question: Tap A can fill a tank in 6 hours, tap B can fill the same tank in 8 hours and tap C can empty the same tank in 4 hours. If all three taps A, B and C are opened together, then how much time (In hours) will be taken to fill the tank?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Tap A can fill a tank in = 6 hours

Tap B can fill the same tank in = 8 hours

Tap C can empty the same tank in = 4 hours

**Formula:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Total work = 24 units (LCM of 6, 8 and 4)

Efficiency of tap A = 4 units/day

Efficiency of tap B = 3 units/day

Efficiency of tap C = -6 units/day

∴ Time taken by A, B and C to fill the tank = 24/(4 + 3 - 6) = 24 hours

questions.question: The marked price and selling price of a book is ₨. 850 and ₨. 748 respectively. The discount in percentage is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

MP of the book = Rs. 850

SP of the book = Rs. 748

**Formula:**

Discount % = (Discount/MP) × 100

**Calculation:**

Discount = Rs. 850 - Rs. 748 = Rs. 102

∴ Discount Percentage = (102/850) × 100 = 12%
